author: ZedHigher
body: Violation imposed by Straightened is totally out of place, why?: -The Map "copied", was never copied, only the base was used, Is that a crime? -In The server rules NEVER said that steal the basis of a map is a crime or a reason to ban, unless a permanent one. Do not you think this is a little out of place? A PERMANENT BAN for stealing only the basis of a map? Can you take the time to download it and watch it in detail and realize that NEVER Map plagiarized or anything like that? PS: If this was an offense to you, sorry, but do not you think it's exaggerated a permanent ban?
